headline: A Great and Highly Consequential Trip
dek: The President flies back from China after a Great and Highly Consequential Trip, and announces a news conference on his trade deals. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Heading back to Washington, D.C., from China. It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip. I will be giving a News Conference tomorrow at 12 P.M., the White House. Also, will be discussing the Trade Deals with Thailand, the Philippines, and others. President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip.
original.context: Posted on 19 November 2026. Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 19 November 2026 (shown as 11/19/26, 9:01 AM Pacific).

meanwhile.hook: Trump returns from a Highly Consequential Trip. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
meanwhile.highlight: It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip.
steve: A Great and Highly Consequential Trip? I know the feeling.
I just drove to the grocery store and back. Highly consequential.
*Next week, I’m negotiating a trade deal with my landlord.*
